transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Hi there! Do you have any questions about your cataract surgery or recovery?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Yes, I do. When can I start doing a little bit of gardening?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: You can go back to light exercise, such as gardening, one week after surgery. However, you should avoid strenuous activities, lifting heavy objects, pilates, yoga, or swimming for a month.

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Great, thank you for letting me know. Another question I have is when can I start using my eye gel for dry eyes?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: You can continue to use any eye drops you were using before your operation, such as for dry eyes, unless you've been told otherwise. Do you have any other questions?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Yes, I do. I'm very sensitive to bright light. Is that normal?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.intended: It's normal for your eyes to be a bit sensitive to light as they adjust to the new lenses. However, significant pain in bright light or severe light sensitivity, especially if your eye is also red and painful, is not normal and may need further assessment. If it's mild and things just seem brighter than you're used to, we recommend wearing sunglasses when going outside. Do you have any other questions?

transcript.speaker: patient
